name: Talmai
bio: Talmai son of Ammihud was king of Geshur, father of David's wife Maacah and grandfather of Absalom (2 Samuel 3:3). After Absalom killed his brother Amnon in revenge for their sister Tamar, he fled to Talmai's protection in Geshur and stayed there three years while David mourned him (2 Samuel 13:37-38).
